questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: A weather app displays details immediately instead of waiting for More. Which placement is suspect?
answers: The details action is in startup code rather than the More handler
The button label uses a capital letter
questions.explanation: Startup code runs without waiting for that button event.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: Two buttons should open different panels. What test checks their routing?
answers: Activate each button and verify its own panel
Click one button and assume the other works
questions.explanation: Each input-to-response mapping needs its own check.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: An alarm handler should update the label and play a tone. What must its code include?
answers: Only a comment naming the tone
questions.explanation: The event response must execute both requested operations.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: Why keep an event handler focused on a clear action?
answers: It makes all other handlers unnecessary
It changes every variable into a constant
Its input and outcome are easier to understand and test
questions.explanation: A focused responsibility makes behavior easier to reason about.
